name: sk-conversation-row
title: Conversation Row
description: A row for the conversation list, with a timestamp that adapts to age — a time today, a weekday this week, a date beyond. Unread is carried by weight and a dot, never by colour alone. Swiping is left to List, which already has the correct physics and accessibility.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKConversationRow(title: "Q3 revenue", preview: last, date: date,
                  isUnread: true) { open() }
